english.title: Conspire to pervert the course of justice
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), conspired together with

(A)_[**(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..)]_
(B)_[**(..SPECIFY THE PERSONS..)]_
(C)_[a person unknown]_
(D)_[other persons unknown]_

to do

(E)_[an act, namely **(..SPECIFY THE ACT..),]_
(F)_[a series of acts, namely **(..SPECIFY THE ACTS..),]_

other.powersofarrest: The power to arrest is the same as the power for the substantive offence.
other.penalty:
Up to life imprisonment where the substantive offence is:
- Murder or other offence where sentence fixed by law;
- An offence where sentence is up to life imprisonment;
- An indictable offence where no maximum term specified.

Imprisonment not exceeding the maximum term available on indictment for the substantive offence (other than offences in (i) above).

A fine in any other case.

Complex - see legislation
